assumptions_resolved: The body of public.queue_nightly_rebuild_style_groups was re-derived line by line from supabase/ci-bootstrap/010_pre_adoption_baseline.sql, the only source of that function in this repository; no competing CREATE OR REPLACE was mechanically merged. The enqueue-arm state object is byte-equivalent to the baseline's, so the PopDAM worker's contract with the rebuild-style-groups object is unchanged.

public.refresh_style_group_counts_batch is declared in claim 2608 and deliberately left untouched. Requirement 4 on issue 2440 is a call-site change, and that function already carries the change predicate from issue 2214. Over-declaring a write is permitted by validateMigrationLease; under-declaring is not.

The reconcile marker is a separate top-level BULK_OPERATIONS key because public.update_bulk_operation (20260819011639) replaces the rebuild-style-groups object wholesale from the caller payload, which would erase a marker stored inside it and destroy the run_id idempotency required by issue 2440 requirement 2.

The advisory lock pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('BULK_OPERATIONS')) is transaction-scoped and is held for the whole reconcile, order 98 seconds once per night, blocking other BULK_OPERATIONS writers for that window. This cost is accepted and documented rather than worked around; releasing it early would reopen the double-fire race the lock closes.

Issue 2440's scope block lists table public.admin_config under reads. The function already writes that table in the baseline body and continues to write exactly the same single row, key = 'BULK_OPERATIONS'. No new table is written. Stated in the migration header and the PR body rather than left to be discovered.

The contract tests WERE executed, from empty, on a disposable local PostgreSQL cluster built the CI way (Supabase roles, extensions, pass-1 replay of every migration, then the captured pre-adoption baseline, then pass 2). That run reproduced the CI failure verbatim and identified its cause: the baseline is applied BETWEEN the two replay passes and its own CREATE OR REPLACE of public.queue_nightly_rebuild_style_groups reverted this migration's body (AFTER_PASS1_IS_NEW_BODY t, then AFTER_BASELINE_IS_NEW_BODY f), so the suite exercised the pre-#2440 armless body while every catalog and cron contract still passed. With the #2440 body actually installed the whole contract file passes end to end, including the positive reconcile and the 7-day floor, and the once-per-UTC-day gate evaluates false as designed. The fix removes the baseline's copy of the function, which is the remedy the baseline's own instructions name; no test and no guard was weakened. The two positive reconcile steps remain guarded on the size of public.style_groups so they skip rather than run a full recompute on a production-sized dataset.

The worker-signalled mechanism preferred by the issue author is PopDAM application work in another repository and is not claimed here; nothing in this migration has to be undone to adopt it. Wiring an alert on last_reconciled_at is likewise application work.
Preview apply, independent review, merge and production promotion were not performed and belong to the orchestrator.
